Tag one and it is promoted on the next build. Nothing else has to change.

## How to fix one

The fastest route is a playlist. The sync reads playlist TITLES and tags every
video inside, so renaming one playlist can tag twenty videos at once. A title
naming both the set and the product does it, the way the existing ones do:
"Perfect Order Booster Bundle Series".

Anything awkward to put in a playlist goes in `data/overrides.json`, which
always wins over whatever the tagger worked out:

    { "dQw4w9WgXcQ": { "sets": ["pitch-black"], "products": ["etb"] } }

Sets the tagger knows: Pitch Black, Ascended Heroes, Pokémon GO, Phantasmal Flames, Perfect Order, Chaos Rising, Mega Evolution, Black Bolt, White Flare, Destined Rivals, Journey Together, Prismatic Evolutions, Surging Sparks, Stellar Crown, Shrouded Fable, Twilight Masquerade, Temporal Forces, Paldean Fates, Paradox Rift, Obsidian Flames, Paldea Evolved, Scarlet & Violet, 151, Crown Zenith, Celebrations, Chilling Reign, Shining Fates, Rebel Clash, Abyss Eye (JP), Ninja Spinner (JP), Nihil Zero (JP), Mega Symphonia (JP), Mega Brave (JP), Stellar Miracle (JP), Cyber Judge (JP), Violet ex (JP), Clay Burst (KR), Crimson Haze (KR), Mask of Change (KR), Battle Partners (KR), Gem Pack Vol. 2 (CN).
